description: Resolve an ADA Handle ($name, or sub@root for subhandles) to the address that currently holds it, with its stake address and whether a script (for example a marketplace listing) holds it. Use it before sending-related answers or to turn a $handle into an address for other tools.

handle.description: Handle with or without the leading $, e.g. "$snek".

name: resolve_handle
title: Resolve an ADA Handle
